night3_start.name: {name}
night3_start.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day.*

night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.text: What you saw today — keep it between us

night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.text: *‘You can come again.’ — For her, that’s the same as saying ‘please come.’*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.text: *Yuna sent a photo of a note. A single line written in her notebook.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.text: That novel, I still haven’t decided on the ending

night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.text: if you wanna ask about my ankle, ask me in person lol

night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.text: *Hidden behind a ‘lol’ — but the sincerity shows through anyway.*

night3_dream_1.name: {name}
night3_dream_1.text: *I had a dream. — I was walking side by side with someone. I couldn't see their face, but strangely I wasn't anxious.*

night3_cheat_msg_1.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_1.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day. I look at my phone.*

night3_cheat_msg_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_2.text: Be that way only with me.

night3_cheat_msg_5.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_5.text: *I just hope you don't take choosing sides lightly.*

night3_cheat_msg_7.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_7.text: *Yuna sent three messages. From someone who normally doesn’t even send one. — That’s how angry she is.*

night3_nightmare_1.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_1.text: *I fell asleep. — A dream. I'm standing in the dark. I can't see anything.*

night3_nightmare_3.name: Seoyeon
night3_nightmare_3.text: You only did that with me...

night3_nightmare_4.name: Yuna
night3_nightmare_4.text: I told you not to lie.

night3_nightmare_5.name: Dain
night3_nightmare_5.text: You said you'd come. I waited.

night3_nightmare_6.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_6.text: *I see hands from three directions. Faintly, in the darkness.*

night3_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_seo.text: *I reached toward Seoyeon. The moment I saw that smile — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_yuna.text: *I stepped toward Yuna. Just as my fingertips were about to touch — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_dain.text: *I ran toward Dain. The moment I thought I had her — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_end.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end.text: *I reached out. — I can't grasp it. They all vanished, and only the dark is left.*

night3_nightmare_end_3.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end_3.text: *— I wake up drenched in sweat. 3 AM. I see the ceiling. I pull out my phone. The gallery. Scrolling again. — Sojeong's photo.*

night3_cheat_reflect_2.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_2.text: *She's smiling. Smiling at me in the group photo. As if asking for help. I told myself I wouldn't look away this time. That at this school, I wouldn't stay silent.*

night3_cheat_reflect_5.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_5.text: *— I won't run. This time, just one person. I had a dream. — I was walking beside someone. I couldn't see their face, but strangely I wasn't anxious.*

night3_faithful_reflect_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_1.text: *I opened my eyes. Morning light seeps through the curtains. — Today's dream was a good one. I picked up my phone. Opened the gallery. Sojeong's photo. — I stopped scrolling and held it down.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3.text: *I kept it because deleting it felt like erasing the guilt too. But now it's not attachment — it's just a record. And that record has served its purpose.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4.text: *This time is different. If I see something wrong, I'll speak up. If I know, I'll act. To one person, clearly — The gallery is empty. The space where Sojeong's photo was. The empty screen is sharper than the photo ever was.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.text: *If the ending stays unwritten, the story never ends. — I feel the same way.*

night3_cheat_msg_3_b.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_3_b.text: *Seoyeon uses the word 'please.' — That word doesn't exist in her vocabulary. That's how far she's shaken.*

night3_cheat_msg_4_b.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_4_b.text: *I just hope you don't take choosing sides lightly.*

night3_dream_2_b.name: {name}
night3_dream_2_b.text: *This time, I wanted to say it without regrets. I told myself I'd live honestly at this school.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.text: *Just like with Sojeong. I knew, and I said nothing. At my old school I watched Sojeong fall apart and kept my mouth shut. And at this school — I did it again.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.text: *At this school, I regret saying it to everyone. The problem was never 'speak up or stay silent' — it was 'to whom.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.text: *Minsu said it. 'Saying no is also love.' Seoyeon said it. 'I won't be one of many.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.text: *Yuna said it. 'Don't run.' So this time has to be different. Not choosing — that's the same as losing everything.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.text: *One second. I just stare at the screen. The scribbles on Sojeong's desk come back to me. And — the 38 mornings I turned my head away.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.text: *...Right. I need to start by saying no to my own past.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.text: *Minsu said it. 'Saying no is also love.' At my old school, Sojeong vanished without anyone helping her. Because I kept my mouth shut. — That was the cruelest ending for both of us. If even one of those 38 messages had been sent — Sojeong might not have left the school.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_b.text: *Deleting the photo was easy. Just one finger, and it's done. — Feelings take much longer.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_c.text: *I closed my phone. The gallery is empty, and my mind is still a mess. — Still, one step forward.*

night3_dream_seo_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_seo_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the feeling of walking beside Seoyeon still lingers.*

night3_dream_yuna_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_yuna_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the quiet air beside Yuna still lingers.*

night3_dream_dain_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_dain_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, Dain's laughter comes back to me a beat later.*
